---
title: "Popularity of the Name Samuel"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Get list of all yearly baby name data files
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "^yob.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read all files and extract the year from the filename
babies <- read_csv(
  files,
  id = "file",
  col_names = c("name", "sex", "n"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(year = parse_number(file)) |>
  select(-file)
```

```{r}
# Filter for "Samuel" over the last 100 years
samuel <- babies |>
  filter(name == "Samuel", year >= max(year) - 99)

samuel |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = sex)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name Samuel (Last 100 Years)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex"
  )
```
